data.name: Pranvika
data.gender_notes: Pranvika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Pran means life force and Vika means gift. So, Pranvika means 'Gift of Prana' or 'Gift of Life'. The name Pranvika carries the meaning “Gift of Prana” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Pranvika usually hope their child will grow to embody gift of prana and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Pranvika is a name given to a baby girl in Hindu culture. It is believed that this name is a blessing from the Gods for the newborn, as it signifies the presence of life force or prana. The name is also considered to be a symbol of creativity and love.
data.etymology: Pranvika belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift of Prana.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pranvika total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
